title: Transfection by Electroporation in Euplotes crassus
author: Angela Piersanti
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.2a9gah6
materials: Each round of transfection 250 µl of cells were used. 0.25 µg of Label IT® Plasmid Delivery Control Cy®3 (Mirus) were added alone or mixed with 2.5 µl of Lipofectamine® 2000 Transfection Reagent (Invitrogen) according to the supplier.
The sample was transferred to the 0.2 cm cuvette. Bio-Rad Gene Pulser was used. Conditions were set as follows: 0.2 kV, 25 µFD, 100 Ω. Time constant around 1.2.

steps.title: Prepare Euplotes crassus cells
steps.instruction: Collect 2x10^4 Euplotes crassus cells and resuspend them in 0.3 M glucose solution (composed of 7% sea water and 93% of 0.3 M glucose solution).

steps.title: Perform electroporation and recovery
steps.instruction: Electroporate the cells and subsequently resuspend them in 3 ml of sea water.

steps.title: Verify plasmid localization
steps.instruction: Immediately after electroporation, use a fluorescent microscope to observe the plasmid in the cytoplasm.
